note: Head swap to Lie24/qwen38-mtp-head-q2q4-cons, declared against the organizer-pinned target and the frontier tree otherwise untouched. Chosen on a structural check rather than a claim: reading the safetensors headers of the published heads with range requests, this one carries the same 40 tensors as the shipped q2-q4-rerank head with EVERY tensor identical in both shape and dtype, so the fused QKV pack and the island-completeness K/V fast path the tree depends on are preserved by construction. Candidates that matched on tensor names but halved mlp.gate_proj / mlp.up_proj from 640 to 320 columns were rejected for that reason. The declared digest is the tree digest the trusted harness specifies -- SHA-256 over "<file sha256>  <relative path>\n" in sorted order, excluding a top-level README.md -- and the implementation was validated by reproducing two independently published manifests before being used here. No source file changes; the head only proposes and the trusted parent re-checks every emitted token against the hidden serial trajectory.
